title: Rule 7 AddressMode table ambiguously permits noncanonical link-local IID mode
description: spec/03-adaptation.md Rule 7 residue table says AddressMode=0 when both addresses are link-local, but the normative prose and uniqueness rule require both addresses specifically in canonical fe80::/64. Implementers following the table could encode fe80::/10 addresses outside /64 in IID-only mode and create an ambiguous/noncanonical wire representation. Change the table wording to the exact fe80::/64 predicate and keep the full-mode rule explicit.
